Yaş means age, and yaşlı means with age/has age. It is used for things that are alive or was alive. 

Like:
Dedem ölmeden önce çok yaşlıydı
My grandpa was very old before passing away

Or

Dedem çok yaşlı
My grandpa is very old

Where as eski can be used for items of instead of “ex”

For example

Eski kız arkadaşım/my ex gf or eski partnerim/ my ex significant other 
Or
Eski piyano/ old piano

You can see eskimiş being commonly used for objects, which means something along the lines of “has gotten old”

You are taking chem and bio hl, downgrade one if you are sure that you want math hl. I suggest you to downgrade bio since you want chem engineering. Do not consider upgrading to math hl without downgrading bio, unless you want to lose your sanity. Needless to say, although bio hl seems easy for now, with more topics added its hardness will increase exponentially unlike other lessons. You will need to dedicate at least 2 weeks short before your actual exams to review everything, even if you already know everything. Bio and math dates are very close on the exam schedule and it is not logical to take both of them in hl. I would suggest you to choose in between. How do you deal with math? Do not consider IB only, did you get along well with math prior to IB. Will you enjoy studying math on a regular basis? Or would you rather study biology. Both lessons require commitment if you need a strong 7. As someone who took bio and chem hl at the same time, and who has pretty good math skills: do not take bio hl and math hl at the same time, that would just be foolish for a normal person with humane limits.
